proposals.evidence: DEDR 3559 explicitly groups Tamil/Malayalam tōl/toli/tokku, Kannada tōl/togal/toval, Telugu tōlu/tokka and Gondi tōl/tolka ‘skin, hide, rind’. These simple skin forms fit the printed family; carma-type Indo-Aryan loans are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
